8064.thb_def:

2.  **Heavens (Abode of God):** The dwelling place of God, often associated with divine power, judgment, and communication. This can also refer to the celestial realm where angels reside.

776.thb_def:

2822.thb_def:

2.  **Obscurity/Secrecy:** A hidden or concealed place or state; something not easily perceived or understood.
3.  **Distress/Misfortune:** A figurative representation of hardship, suffering, or a time of trouble.
4.  **Ignorance/Confusion:** A state of lacking knowledge or understanding; mental or spiritual blindness.
5.  **Withholding/Restraining:** To hold back something, whether it be a physical object, an emotion, or a blessing.

As a rule אֲשֶׁר is a mere connecting link, and requires to be supplemented (see the grammars) by a pronominal affix, or other word, such as שָׁם, defining the nature of the relation more precisely — • it includes its pronominal antecedent, whether in the nominative or oblique cases
• instances of אֲשֶׁר followed by a pronominal affix, or by שָׁם, שָֽׁמָּה, מִשָּׁם, are so common that the examples cited above will be sufficient
• sometimes (though rarely) the defining adjunct is a pronoun of 1 or 2 person as well as of 3 person. In such cases it is strictly to be rendered I who . . ., thou who, etc
• the defining pronominal adjunct is dispensed with
• sometimes in poetry = one who, a man who (men who )
• occasionally receives its closer definition by a substantive following it, in other words, its logical antecedent is inserted in the relative clause
• ׳ אֲשֶׁר ל that (belongs, belong, belonged) to, is used
• אֲשֶׁר becomes, like Aramaic דּי, , a conjunction approximating in usage to כִּי

Origin/Material: of, made from: מִזָּהָב of gold. 4. Comparative: than (with adjectives of comparison): טוֹב מִ better than. 5. Causal: because of, due to, by reason of: מִיִּרְאָה because of fear. 6. Privative: without, free from: מִבְּלִי without. 7. Temporal: from, since, after: מֵאָז since then.
m.strongs_def: from, out of, of, than, because of, some of
m.thb_def:
1.  **From:** Indicates separation, departure, or origin. (e.g., "נָסוּ מִ פְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים" - "they fled from the face of the Philistines")
2.  **Out of:** Indicates extraction or selection from a group or source. (e.g., "מִן הַ שְּׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים" - "out of the thirty")
3.  **Than:** Used in comparisons. (e.g., "נִכְבָּ֖ד מֵ אֶחָ֑י ו" - "more honored than his brothers")
4.  **Part of:** Indicates membership or inclusion within a group. (e.g., "מִן בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן" - "from the sons of Simeon")
5.  **Because of/Due to:** Indicates the reason or cause of something. (e.g., "מִ פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵי כֶֽם" - "because of the evil of your deeds")

3947.thb_def:
1.  To take, seize, or grasp physically: This is the most basic meaning, referring to the act of taking something into one's hand or possession.
2.  To take and carry: This extends the basic meaning to include the idea of taking something along with oneself, often implying movement or transportation.
3.  To take from, remove, or deprive: This sense involves taking something away from someone or something else, often resulting in a loss or reduction.
4.  To take for oneself, acquire, or procure: This refers to taking something for one's own benefit or use, often implying ownership or possession.
5.  To take in marriage: A specific and common usage referring to the act of marrying someone.
6.  To receive, accept, or obtain: This sense involves receiving something, whether it be a physical object, a gift, or even an abstract concept like instruction or a command.
7.  To fetch, bring, or summon: This refers to the act of going to get something or someone and bringing them back.
8.  To lead, conduct, or guide: This sense involves taking someone to a specific location or leading them in a particular direction.
9.  To capture, seize, or conquer: This refers to taking something by force, such as a city, territory, or possession.
10. To carry away as booty or prisoners: This involves taking people or goods as spoils of war or as captives.

4503.thb_def:
1.  **Gift, Present:** A voluntary contribution given to express respect, goodwill, or to seek favor, often presented to individuals of higher status or authority. This includes instances of diplomatic gifts between rulers or personal gifts.
2.  **Tribute:** A mandatory payment or offering imposed by a dominant power upon a subjugated people or kingdom, signifying submission and ensuring continued peace or protection.
3.  **Offering (General):** A voluntary or prescribed offering presented to God or a deity, encompassing a wide range of sacrifices and contributions intended to appease, honor, or seek divine favor. This can include animal sacrifices, grain, or other valuable items.
4.  **Grain Offering (Specific):** A specific type of offering made to God, consisting primarily of grain or flour, often prepared in a specific manner (e.g., baked, mixed with oil, with frankincense) and presented according to prescribed rituals. This is particularly common in the context of the sacrificial system detailed in Leviticus and other priestly texts.

3999.strongs_def: 1) flood,  deluge. 1a) Noah's flood that submerged the entire planet earth under water for about a year ++++ Some think Noah's flood was only local. However the description of it found in Gen. 6 through 8 makes this patently absurd. If it was local, Noah had 120 years to migrate out of the area to safe ground! Why waste all that effort building a ship? He only had to move less than 1500 feet a day to reach the farthest point on the globe! With the possible exception of Ps 29:10,  this word always refers to Noah's flood. The real reason for insisting on a local flood is the acceptance of evolution with its long geological ages. **Scratchpaper:**
The noun "אֲרֻבָּה" (arubbah) has a wider semantic range than "ארבה," referring to openings or apertures. The BDB defines it as "lattice, window, sluice." The MT contexts support this, with instances referring to openings in the sky (sluices for rain), windows (possibly latticed), and even metaphorical references to eyes. The Hosea reference uses it in the context of smoke escaping, suggesting a chimney-like opening. Isaiah 60:8 refers to dove-cotes. The key is that it's an opening that allows something to pass through.

---

1.  A window or lattice; an opening in a wall or structure to allow light, air, or viewing.
2.  A sluice or aperture in the sky; used to describe the openings from which rain or blessings are poured out.
3.  (Figuratively) An eye socket (Ecclesiastes 12:3).
4.  An opening for smoke to escape (Hosea 13:3).
5.  Openings of a dove-cote (Isaiah 60:8).
699.strongs_def: 1) lattice,  window,  sluice 2) (CLBL) chimney (lattice opening where smoke escapes)

**Scratchpaper:** The lemma "מזבח" (mizbeach) consistently refers to an altar, a structure used for offering sacrifices to a deity. The BDB definition confirms this, tracing the word's origins to a "place of slaughter." The MT contexts overwhelmingly support this meaning, detailing the construction, dedication, desecration, and use of altars in various religious practices, both legitimate and idolatrous. The altar serves as a focal point for worship, a place of refuge, and a site for atonement rituals. The MT distinguishes between altars for Yahweh and those for other deities like Baal. The material composition (earth, unhewn stones, bronze, gold) and specific features (horns, foundations) of the altar are sometimes mentioned, highlighting its physical characteristics and ritual significance.

3956.thb_def:
1.  **Tongue (physical organ):** The fleshy organ in the mouth used for tasting, lapping, and speech. This includes literal references to the tongue's physical state (e.g., cleaving to the palate in thirst) and its role in physical actions.
2.  **Speech/Language (faculty of communication):** The ability to speak, encompassing both the act of speaking and the content of what is spoken. This includes truthful and deceitful speech, singing, and the general capacity for communication. Often used in parallel with שָׂפָה (lip/speech).
3.  **Language (a system of communication):** A specific system of words and grammar used by a particular nation or group of people. This refers to distinct languages like Hebrew, Ashdodite, or the languages of various nations.
4.  **Tongue (of animals):** The physical tongue of animals.
5.  **Tongue (of fire):** A flame or stream of fire, often used metaphorically to describe devouring or destructive power.
6.  **Tongue-shaped object:** An object or geographical feature resembling a tongue in shape, such as a wedge of gold or a bay of the sea.

1293.thb_def:
1.  **Blessing (divine favor):** The most common meaning, referring to the bestowal of divine favor, prosperity, or well-being. This can be from God to people, or from people to other people. Examples include Deuteronomy 28:2 ("all these blessings shall come upon you"), Genesis 12:2 ("be a blessing"), and Psalm 3:9 ("Your blessing be upon Your people").
2.  **Source of blessing:** Used to describe someone or something that brings blessings to others. Examples include Isaiah 19:24 ("a blessing in the midst of the earth") and Psalm 37:26 ("his descendants are a blessing").
3.  **Gift, present:** Refers to a tangible gift given as a token of goodwill or favor. Examples include Genesis 33:11 ("Take my gift that is brought to you") and 1 Samuel 25:27 ("This present which your maidservant has brought to my lord").
4.  **Pool, reservoir:** Refers to a body of water, often artificial. Examples include 1 Kings 22:38 ("the pool of Samaria") and 2 Kings 20:20 ("the pool and the conduit").
5.  **Treaty of peace:** Used in the context of making a treaty or agreement, possibly implying a peaceful or beneficial arrangement. Example: 2 Kings 18:31 ("Make your peace with me").
6.  **Praise of God:** Used to express praise and adoration to God. Example: Nehemiah 9:5 ("Bless the Lord your God").

2436.thb_def:
1.  **Bosom/Lap (physical):** The fold of a garment at the breast, or the chest area, used for carrying or concealing something. Examples include carrying a child (Ruth 4:16, Numbers 11:12), concealing a hand (Exodus 4:6-7), or an object being placed there (Proverbs 16:33).
2.  **Bosom/Chest (relational/intimate):** Referring to the area of the chest in the context of relationships, often marital or familial. Examples include lying in someone's bosom (1 Kings 1:2, Micah 7:5, Deuteronomy 13:7, 28:54, 28:56), or a wife/concubine in relation to a man (Genesis 16:5, 2 Samuel 12:8, Proverbs 5:20).
3.  **Inner Part/Midst:** Referring to the inner part of something, either a person or an object. Examples include anger residing within (Ecclesiastes 7:9), the interior of a chariot (1 Kings 22:35), or the hollow of an altar (Ezekiel 43:13, 43:14, 43:17).
4.  **Figurative - Requital/Recompense:** Used metaphorically to represent requiting or repaying something, often negative, into someone's "bosom" as a form of recompense. Examples include repaying sins (Isaiah 65:6-7, Jeremiah 32:18, Psalms 79:12).
5.  **Figurative - Place of Grief/Insult:** Used to describe carrying grief, insults, or burdens. Examples include carrying insults (Psalms 89:51), or the soul pouring out (Lamentations 2:12).
6.  **Internal/Emotional:** Referring to internal feelings or thoughts. Examples include kidneys consumed within (Job 19:27), or hiding words in one's breast (Job 23:12).
7.  **Affectionate Carrying:** Used to describe carrying something with affection or care (2 Samuel 12:3, Isaiah 40:11, 1 Kings 3:20, 1 Kings 17:19).
8.  **Prayer:** Referring to prayer returning to one's own bosom (Psalms 35:13).
9.  **Bribery:** Referring to bribery (Proverbs 17:23, Proverbs 21:14).

2.  **To oppress, subjugate, or mistreat (figuratively):** This meaning appears in contexts where individuals or groups are being subjected to harsh treatment or injustice, such as the oppression of the poor (Amos 4:1) or the exploitation of others (1 Samuel 12:3-4). 8451.bdb_def: (noun feminine) direction, instruction, law: (properly direction) — • (properly direction)
8451.thb_def:
1.  **Instruction/Teaching:** General guidance or teaching, whether from human sources (parents, sages) or divine sources (prophets, priests). This includes moral instruction, wisdom teachings, and practical guidance.
2.  **Law:** Specific laws, statutes, or legal codes, often referring to specific commandments or sets of rules within the Mosaic Law. This can refer to individual laws, collections of laws, or the entire legal system.
3.  **The Pentateuch:** The first five books of the Hebrew Bible (Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy), also known as the Five Books of Moses. This is the core of the written Torah.
4.  **Body of Teaching/Doctrine:** A broader sense encompassing the entire body of Jewish religious teachings, including both written and oral traditions. This represents the totality of God's revealed will and guidance for the Jewish people.
5.  **Custom/Manner:** In at least one instance (2 Samuel 7:19), it refers to a custom or manner, specifically "the manner of man."

**Scratchpaper:** The lemma סכות appears as a proper noun, referring to two distinct locations: one east of the Jordan River and another as the first station of the Israelites during the Exodus. In Amos, the form סכות seems to refer to a deity (Sikkuth) or a portable shrine. The BDB distinguishes between סֻכּוֺת (H5523) and סִכּוּת (H5522), which is important. The verses in Kings and Chronicles refer to the location east of the Jordan, related to metalworking. The Exodus and Numbers verses refer to the location in the Exodus narrative. The Judges verses describe events in the city of Sukkot east of the Jordan. The Psalms verses place Sukkot in the Jordan Valley. The Amos verse is unique and requires careful consideration, as it may refer to a deity or a portable shrine of a deity. Some scholars suggest "Sikkuth" is related to the god Saturn.

1.  **Sukkoth (east of the Jordan):** A city located east of the Jordan River, in the territory of Gad, often associated with events in the book of Judges, situated between Penuel and Shechem, and metalworking in Kings and Chronicles. Identified by some with Tell Deir 'Alla.
2.  **Sukkoth (Exodus station):** The first encampment of the Israelites after departing from Ramses in Egypt during the Exodus. Possibly located in the Wadi Tumilat.
3.  **Sikkuth (deity/shrine):** A deity or portable shrine, possibly associated with astral worship or the god Saturn, mentioned in Amos 5:26. The Masoretic vocalization may have deliberately altered the name to associate it with "abomination."

2891.thb_def:
1.  To be clean, pure, or free from impurity in a physical sense, often achieved through washing or other physical acts. This can refer to being cleansed from leprosy, as seen in the story of Naaman in 2 Kings, or the cleansing of objects.
2.  To be ceremonially clean, often in the context of ritual purity as prescribed in the Torah, particularly in Leviticus and Numbers. This involves specific rituals and offerings to remove ritual impurity.

5. To cleanse, purify, or declare clean (Piel stem), often involving a specific action or ritual performed by a priest or designated individual.
6. To purify oneself (Hithpael stem), indicating a reflexive action of seeking purification, often in preparation for sacred duties or after defilement.

2.  To hang (a person) as a form of execution or public display: This usage often involves hanging a person on a tree or gallows as a punishment or to display their body. The eggs deposited beneath her body were thus protected until the larvae were hatched and able to enter their own life cycle. As the mother died,  the crimson fluid stained her body and the surrounding wood. From the dead bodies of such female scarlet worms,  the commercial scarlet dyes of antiquity were extracted. 530.thb_def:
1.  **Faithfulness, reliability, trustworthiness (human):** This refers to the quality of being dependable and honest in one's actions and dealings. Examples include being faithful in office (2 Kings 12:16, 22:7, 2 Chronicles 19:9, 31:12, 34:12, 1 Chronicles 9:22, 9:26, 9:31, 2 Chronicles 31:15, 31:18), speaking truth (Proverbs 12:17), and being the opposite of deceitful (Proverbs 12:22, Jeremiah 9:2).
2.  **Faithfulness, reliability, trustworthiness (divine):** This describes God's consistent and dependable nature, His adherence to His promises, and the reliability of His actions. Examples include God's faithfulness enduring to all generations (Psalms 100:5, 119:90), His faithfulness reaching to the skies (Psalms 36:6), and His faithfulness being demonstrated in His works and commands (Psalms 33:4, 119:86). It is often associated with God's loving-kindness (Psalms 89:25, 92:3, 98:3, Hosea 2:22), righteousness (Psalms 96:13, 143:1, Isaiah 11:5), and salvation (Psalms 40:11).
3.  **Steadfastness, firmness:** This refers to the quality of being firm, stable, and unwavering. An example is found in Exodus 17:12, where Aaron and Hur hold up Moses' hands so that they remain steady. Another example is in Isaiah 33:6, where it refers to the steadfastness of the times.
4.  **Truth:** In some contexts, אמונה can refer to truth itself, as opposed to falsehood or deceit. Examples include Isaiah 25:1, Psalms 119:138, 119:30, Jeremiah 5:1, 5:3, 7:28.
5.  **Faith:** In Habakkuk 2:4, it refers to the faith by which the righteous live.

Examples: 1 Chronicles 16:18, 1 Kings 4:13, Deuteronomy 3:4, 13, 14, 32:9, Joshua 17:14, 19:9, 29, Amos 7:17, Ezekiel 47:13, Psalms 105:11, 78:55, Zechariah 2:5, Zephaniah 2:5, 6, 7.

**Scratchpaper:**
The lemma פקדה appears in a variety of contexts, reflecting its multifaceted meaning. The BDB definitions are helpful, but the MT contexts reveal nuances. It can refer to a specific task or duty assigned to someone, a mustering of troops, a general sense of oversight or governance, or a time of divine visitation (often punitive). The connection to the verb פקד (to visit, to number, to appoint) is clear. The specific nuance is highly context-dependent. The phrase "year of visitation" often implies a time of divine judgment. In some cases, it refers to a store or deposit.

---

1.  **Oversight/Charge:** A duty, responsibility, or assigned task, often in a Levitical or military context.
2.  **Mustering:** A gathering or enrollment, particularly of soldiers.
3.  **Visitation:** A time of divine intervention, often carrying a connotation of judgment or punishment.
4.  **Office/Post:** A position of authority or responsibility.
5.  **Store/Deposit:** A collection of items or resources.
6486.strongs_def: 1) oversight,  care,  custody,  mustering, visitation,  store 1a) visitation,  punishment 1b) oversight,  charge,  office,  overseer,  class of officers 1c) mustering 1d) store

8252.bdb_def:
(verb) be quiet, undisturbed: of land — • of land
• = be pacified
• (inner causative)
8252.thb_def:
1.  To be quiet, undisturbed, or at peace (Qal): This meaning applies to land, cities, kingdoms, or people, often in the context of being free from war or disturbance. Examples include land being at peace after a conflict (Joshua 11:23, Judges 3:11, 3:30, 5:31, 8:28, Isaiah 14:7), a city being quiet (2 Kings 11:20, 2 Chronicles 23:21), or people living in peace and security (Judges 18:7, 18:27, Ezekiel 38:11, Jeremiah 30:10, 46:27). It can also describe a more general state of rest or tranquility (Job 3:13, 3:26).
2.  To be inactive or still (Qal): This meaning describes a state of being quiet in the sense of not acting or intervening. Examples include Isaiah 18:4, where God says He will be quiet and gaze, and Psalm 83:2, where the speaker pleads with God not to be silent.
3.  To cease from conflict or be pacified (Qal): This meaning is specific to contexts involving conflict or agitation, where the verb describes the cessation of such activity. Examples include Jeremiah 47:6-7, where the sword is urged to be quiet, and Ruth 3:18, where Boaz will not rest until he finishes the matter.
4.  To cause quietness, pacify, or show quietness (Hiphil): This causative meaning indicates an action that brings about a state of quiet or peace. Examples include Proverbs 15:18, where a patient person calms strife, Job 34:29, where God brings quiet, and Isaiah 7:4, where one is told to remain calm and not fear. It can also refer to the state of quietness itself (Isaiah 30:15, 32:17, Ezekiel 16:49).
8252.strongs_def: 1) to be quiet,  be tranquil,  be at peace,  be quiet,  rest,  lie still, be undisturbed 1a) (Qal) 1a1) to be quiet,  be undisturbed 1a1a) to be at peace (of land) 1a2) to be quiet,  be inactive 1b) (Hiphil) 1b1) to show quietness 1b1a) quietness,  display of quietness (subst) 1b2) to quiet,  be quiet 1b3) to cause quietness,  pacify,  allay

The distribution of the noun is concentrated in historical/military contexts, while the verb is more broadly distributed across wisdom literature and historical narratives.

6598+.thb_def:
1.  **Royal Provisions/Food:** A portion of food, often rich or choice, provided by a king or ruler, typically from the royal table. This is evident in Daniel 1:5, 1:13, 1:15, 1:16, and 1:8, where it is consistently referred to as "the king's patbag" and is something that is "eaten".
2.  **Royal Delicacies/Rations:** Specifically, the luxurious or specially prepared food and drink served at a royal court, often contrasted with simpler fare. This is supported by its pairing with "wine of his drink" (Daniel 1:5, 1:8, 1:16) and its contrast with "vegetables" (Daniel 1:13, 1:15, 1:16), implying a higher quality or richer diet.
3.  **Symbol of Royal Patronage/Dependence:** The sustenance provided by a ruler, implying a relationship of loyalty, dependence, or obligation on the part of the recipient. Daniel's refusal to eat it to avoid defilement (Daniel 1:8) and the statement in Daniel 11:26 about "those who eat his patbag" breaking him, suggest that partaking of this food signifies a commitment or dependence on the king.

9002.bdb_def: 1. Copulative: and, also, both...and (connecting words, phrases, clauses). 2. Adversative: but, yet, however, while. 3. Consequential: so, therefore, and so, then. 4. Circumstantial: while, when, though, although. 5. Waw-consecutive with imperfect (wayy- form): marks sequential past narrative. 6. Waw-consecutive with perfect: marks future sequence. 7. Resumptive: now, then.
9002.strongs_def: and, but, then, also, so, even
9002.thb_def:
1.  And: Used to connect words, phrases, or clauses, indicating addition or continuation.
2.  But: Used to indicate contrast or opposition between two elements.
3.  Then: Used to indicate sequence or consequence, often at the beginning of a clause.
4.  So: Used to indicate a result or purpose.
5.  (Vav-conversive): Prefix on verbs, modifying their tense/aspect (context dependent).

9003.strongs_def: in, with, at, by, among, through, because of
9003.thb_def:
1.  In, within (expressing location or containment)
2.  At (indicating a point in time or space)
3.  With, by means of (denoting instrumentality or accompaniment)
4.  Among (indicating inclusion within a group)
5.  Because of, on account of (expressing cause or reason)
6.  Concerning, regarding (denoting the subject of a statement)
7.  Against (expressing opposition)

9004.bdb_def:
the like of, like, as: properly substantive the like of, like, as — • quantitatively
• repeated, כְּכְּ֗֗֗, to signify the completeness of the correspondency between two objects (peculiar to Hebrew)
• before an infinitive
9004.strongs_def: from, out of, of, than, because of, some of
9004.thb_def:
1.  **From:** Indicates separation, departure, or origin. (e.g., "נָסוּ מִ פְּנֵי פְלִשְׁתִּים" - "they fled from the face of the Philistines")
2.  **Out of:** Indicates extraction or selection from a group or source. (e.g., "מִן הַ שְּׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים" - "out of the thirty")
3.  **Than:** Used in comparisons. (e.g., "נִכְבָּ֖ד מֵ אֶחָ֑י ו" - "more honored than his brothers")
4.  **Part of:** Indicates membership or inclusion within a group. (e.g., "מִן בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן" - "from the sons of Simeon")
5.  **Because of/Due to:** Indicates the reason or cause of something. (e.g., "מִ פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵי כֶֽם" - "because of the evil of your deeds")

9005.bdb_def:
(preposition) to, for, in regard to: denoting direction (not properly motion, as אֶל) towards, or reference to; and hence used in many varied applications, in some of which the idea of direction predominates, in others that of reference — • with verbs of: very often, with various classes of verbs, to, towards, for
• Expressing locality
• To denote the object of a verb
• of a transition into a new state or condition, or into a new character or office
• those which are not: defining those in reference to whom a predicate is affirmed, hence often =
• Of time
• With an Infinitive
9005.strongs_def: to, for, of, towards, belonging to, in order to
9005.thb_def:
1.  **Direction/Motion:** To, toward (indicating movement or orientation).
2.  **Purpose/Intention:** For (indicating the reason or goal of an action).
3.  **Possession/Belonging:** Of, belonging to (indicating ownership or association).
4.  **Relationship/Association:** To, for, with respect to (indicating a connection or correspondence).
5.  **Dative marker:** (Indicates the indirect object of a verb, similar to "to" in "give something to someone").
6.  **Designation/Identity:** As, for (used to define or identify something).
7.  **Time:** At, for (referring to a point or duration in time).

9006.bdb_def: 1. Like, as, resembling: כַּמַּיִם like water. 2. According to, in accordance with, as prescribed by: כְּדָבָר הַזֶּה according to this word. 3. In proportion to, to the degree of. 4. Approximately, about (with numbers): כִּשְׁלֹשִׁים about thirty. 5. Temporal: when, as, as soon as (with infinitive construct): כְּשָׁמְעוֹ when he heard. 6. Asseverative: indeed, truly (rare).
9006.strongs_def: like, as, according to, when, about

9009.bdb_def:
(definite article) the: joined with substantives — • joined with substantives
• With adjectives, participles, and demonstrative pronouns
• The article is prefixed exceptionally — mostly in the latest Hebrew — with the force of a relative to the verb
9009.thb_def: 1.  The definite article "the," used to specify a noun.
